line4: I'm a game developer and I've been passionate about games for as long as I can remember now I get to turn that passion into a career, working with Unity, C#, and Unreal Engine.
line5: I've worked on a good range of projects: hack and slash combat systems, real-time multiplayer games with Netcode for GameObjects, crafting and merge mechanics, and isometric worlds.
line6: I like understanding how every piece of a game fits together, from the code behind the mechanics to the experience the player actually feels.
line7: I'm always learning something new a new engine, a tool, a technique because that's what keeps the work interesting.
